title: tf2: coordinate frames and transforms
keywords: tf tf2 transform transforms frame frames tree fixed_frame tf_static view_frames tf2_echo extrapolation lookup
text: tf2 keeps the tree of coordinate frames over time, for example map -> odom -> base_link -> laser. Transforms come from /tf (moving parts such as odometry) and /tf_static (fixed mounts, often from robot_state_publisher). Every frame has exactly one parent and the tree must be connected: a lookup fails with "frame does not exist" or an extrapolation error when a link is missing or timestamps are out of range. ros2 run tf2_tools view_frames draws the tree and ros2 run tf2_ros tf2_echo map base_link prints one transform. In RViz the Fixed Frame must exist in this tree, otherwise nothing is drawn.
